content: MSUD Maxamaid is a specialized medical food designed for the dietary management of maple syrup urine disease (MSUD) in children aged 1 to 8 years. It is an orange-flavored powdered formula that is free of isoleucine, leucine, and valine. Each 100 grams of the powder provides 25 grams of protein equivalent. The product is not intended for use as the sole source of nutrition and must be consumed under medical supervision. Intake should be adjusted to support normal growth and development, and it must be used in conjunction with natural protein, fluids, and other nutrients in quantities prescribed by a physician or dietitian. This ensures that the patient’s isoleucine, leucine, valine, and general nutritional requirements are met. MSUD Maxamaid is not suitable for children under 1 year of age and is not intended for parenteral use. It is also not indicated for use during pregnancy or lactation, as it is specifically formulated for pediatric use only. No controlled studies have been conducted on this product, and it is not classified under a pregnancy category due to its pediatric-specific application. However, in general, controlled studies in pregnant women for similar products have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
